data.title: Numbers — Starter · Lesson 3
data.subject: numbers
data.lyrics:
(Alright now)

[Hook]
Vamos a la playa… Let's hit the shore
Sunshine on my face… y el sol que brilla más
Uno, dos, tres, cuatro… Let's count some more
Come on, let's go, let's dance.

[Verse]
Sun's up, it's getting hot…
Tres… three amigos, what a lot.
Building castles in the sand…
Mitad… half the size, but twice as grand.
Waves are crashing, seagulls cry…
Doble… double the fun beneath the sky.
Ice cream truck, can't you see…
Triple… triple the scoops for you and me.

[Hook]
Vamos a la playa… Let's hit the shore
Sunshine on my face… y el sol que brilla más
Uno, dos, tres, cuatro… Let's count some more
Come on, let's go, let's dance.

[Verse]
Seashells scattered all around…
Cuádruple… quadruple the treasures that we've found.
Time flies when you're having fun…
Décuplo… tenfold the memories, every one.
Counting waves as they roll in…
Décima… tenth wave's the one we dive in.
Quince… fifteen shells, a perfect score…

[Bridge]
Vigésimo… twentieth wave, let's make a wish.
